trial_court: Family Court Raipur (C.G.) - Civil Suit No. 216/2021
case_name: Gurjeet Kour @ Rinki vs Baljeet Singh @ Vikki
facts_of_case: Marriage of the petitioner and respondent was solemnized on 28.01.2001. A child has been born. The petitioner started residing in her parental house at District Bilaspur (C.G.) with her old aged mother.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a case to another court if it is inconvenient for the petitioner to attend proceedings in the original court.
legal_principles.held: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, further considering the fact that the Petitioner is a lady, having a child and residing with her old aged mother at District Bilaspur(C.G.) which is 120 kms. far from District: Raipur (C.G.).

legal_principles.principle: A court may consider the distance between the parties' residences when deciding whether to transfer a case.
legal_principles.held: Further, firstly the Petitioner/wife moved an application for grant of maintenance before Family Court Bilaspur thereafter the Respondent/husband filed an application for taking divorce in Family Court Raipur (C.G.).

outcome.final_order: The case filed by the respondent/husband which is pending before the learned IInd Additional Principal Judge, Family Court Raipur (C.G.) may be transferred to the Court of learned Principal Judge, Family Court Bilaspur, District Bilaspur(C.G.).
